official_sources.name: EA LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles

verified_facts: site-specific LIDAR surveys have been carried out across England since 1998
the DTM removes surface objects from the DSM
tiles are supplied as GeoTIFF in 5km zip files
heights are metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn
data is aligned to the OS Grid
vertical accuracy is plus or minus 15cm RMSE
metadata index catalogues provide survey date resolution transformation and geoidal model for a location
quality_effect: Requires survey-specific date, resolution, transformation and geoid before a timestamped elevation can support a candidate.
